intro: Sandhadi 6 is the latest Telugu Christmas song written by Dr Shalem Raj & Azuba Daniel kalyanapu, tuned & music composed by Dr Shalem Raj, John Gideon, Alfred Kalyanapu and produced by Pastor Daniel D Kalyanapu. This song was released on December 21, 2023 through Dr Shalem Raj YouTube channel.
